title: Dairy farming: introduction
competency: Explain what a dairy and dairy farming are.

keywords.def: A business that harvests or processes animal milk for people.
A class of agriculture for long-term production of milk.
Foods made from milk, like yogurt, cheese and butter.

en.text: A dairy is a business that harvests or processes animal milk for people, mostly from cows, but also from goats, sheep or camels. Dairy farming is a class of agriculture for long-term production of milk. Dairy products include yogurt, cheese and butter.

screens.title: Brainstorming
screens.ask: What activities are done when milking a cow in your area?
opts: Washing hands and udder, then milking into a clean pot
screens.after: Milking needs clean hands, a clean udder and a clean container. Read about dairies.

screens.title: 3.2.1 Introduction
paras: A dairy is a business that harvests or processes animal milk for people.
The milk comes mostly from cows, but also from goats, sheep or camels.
A dairy farm produces milk. A dairy factory processes it into products.

screens.title: Dairy farming and products
paras: Dairy farming is a class of agriculture for long-term production of milk.
Dairy products are foods made from milk.
They include yogurt, cheese and butter.
Farmers can earn extra money by selling milk in town.

screens.text: ___ is a class of agriculture for long-term production of milk.
screens.why: Cattle and cow are animals. Fattening is for meat.
screens.clue: Which one is a type of farming for milk?

screens.why: Dairy products are made from milk. Honey and eggs are not.

screens.text: Dairy milk can come from camels.
Hiwot has 3 cows. She makes butter and ayib to sell at the market. What is her business?
screens.why: She harvests and processes milk into dairy products for people. That is a dairy business.

test.text: A dairy factory processes milk into products.
test.why: The farm produces; the factory processes.

test.text: Dairy farming is for short-term meat production.
test.why: It is for long-term milk production.
